mathematics.assertion_tested: Independent stress/current and integrated mass-constraint checks on exactly five saved full-gradient profiles, including comparison of pure-X local chemical frequency and declared R99 compactness against a proposed universal extension of the old TF caps.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64, numpy trapezoidal quadrature of finite saved grids
mathematics.conventions: Pure-X reference source M=1 and 4*pi*G=1, embedded in declared m=M/(2sqrt(1+u_star^2)), lambda=.01, g^2=lambda*(M^2-4m^2)/(1+r). Mixed profile uses its saved parameters. R99 encloses 99 percent of truncated ADM mass; C99=G*totalADM/R99.
non_claims: Not a new BVP solve, interval proof or all-parameter statement.
No radial, angular, nonlinear or quantum stability assertion.
Pure-X fields are outside the original positive-both-amplitudes TF theorem. R99 is not its zero-pressure radius.
Finite grids, tail truncation and floating arithmetic remain numerical approximations.
